verdict.rationale: Vanta can be driven headlessly through its API. You get an access token and use it to list documents, policies and evidence. Scripts can push custom resources and turn them into Custom Tests, run bulk uploads and owner assignments, and receive webhook events instead of polling. Official type-safe SDKs exist, but only for the Auditor API. However, there is no evidence of a CLI, a CI-native integration (e.g. a pipeline action), or CI-specific guidance, so CI use means hand-building scripts against the API. missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration, documented CI/pipeline workflows, SDKs beyond the Auditor API, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
